A dental implant is a fixed replacement for a missing tooth: a titanium post is placed in the jawbone as an artificial root and, once it has grown into the bone, a custom-made crown is attached. Implants restore chewing function and help to preserve the jawbone. MedLuxLife arranges your online consultation with the dentist in Istanbul and organises your stay.

Quick facts

Anaesthesia

Local anaesthesia

Trips to Türkiye

Usually 2

1st visit

About 3–5 days

Healing time

3–6 months

2nd visit

About 5–7 days

General information; your dentist plans the details for you personally.

Who it may be suitable for

  • You are missing one or more teeth and would like a fixed replacement.
  • Your gums are healthy and there is enough jawbone – if not, bone grafting or a sinus lift can help.
  • You are in good general health and ready to keep up good oral hygiene.

Whether the treatment is suitable for you is decided by the dentist after a personal assessment.

Options

Single implant

Replaces one tooth with an implant and a crown.

Several implants

Implant-supported crowns or bridges replace several teeth.

Bone grafting or sinus lift

Builds up the bone if there is not enough for an implant.

How the treatment works

Preparation and anaesthesia

The dentist discusses your wishes and examines your teeth and jaw. The implant is placed under local anaesthesia.

Implant placement

A titanium post is placed precisely into the jawbone as an artificial tooth root.

Healing (osseointegration)

Over the next 3–6 months, the implant grows firmly into the jawbone – you return home in the meantime.

Crown placement

On your second visit, the custom-made crown is attached to the implant.

2Your personal plan

3Arrival and treatment

After an examination, the treatment takes place as planned. The implant is placed on your first visit; the crown follows on a second visit after 3–6 months.

4Your time in Istanbul

Between the appointments you can rest in your hotel or explore the city. The dentist decides when the treatment is complete.

5Back home

Stay in touch with us on WhatsApp – we help with follow-up questions.

Healing step by step

First days

Mild swelling and discomfort after the numbness wears off are treated with mild painkillers; most people resume light activities the next day.

Months 3–6

The implant grows firmly into the jawbone (osseointegration). You are at home during this time.

Second visit

The permanent crown is fitted – about 5–7 days in Türkiye.

Frequently asked questions

Rhinoplasty reshapes the bone and cartilage of the nose – to change its size or shape, to correct an asymmetry or, where needed, to improve breathing. The plan is made together with your surgeon. MedLuxLife arranges your online consultation with the surgeon in Istanbul and organises your stay.

Quick facts

Anaesthesia

Usually general anaesthesia

Operation time

About 2–4 hours

Hospital stay

Usually 1 night

Nasal splint

Removed after 5–7 days

Stay in Türkiye

Planned individually with the clinic

General information; your surgeon plans the details for you personally.

Who it may be suitable for

  • You would like to change the shape or size of your nose.
  • You have breathing problems, for example because of a deviated septum.
  • The growth of your face is complete.
  • You are in good general health and do not smoke, or are ready to stop for the surgery.

Whether the procedure is suitable for you is decided by the surgeon after a personal assessment.

Types of rhinoplasty

Cosmetic rhinoplasty

Changes the size, tip or nostrils, or corrects an asymmetry.

Functional rhinoplasty

Septorhinoplasty improves breathing, for example with a deviated septum.

How the operation is performed

Consultation before surgery

The surgeon examines your facial structure, discusses your wishes and makes a personal surgical plan.

Anaesthesia and preparation

You receive general anaesthesia or local anaesthesia with sedation. The area is prepared and precise markings guide the reshaping.

Reshaping the nose

Through small incisions inside the nostrils or at the base of the nose, the surgeon reshapes bone and cartilage – shape, size and symmetry – and corrects breathing problems where needed.

Closure and recovery

The incisions are closed carefully and a splint supports the new shape. You are monitored closely and receive a personal aftercare plan.

The doctor for this treatment

Which doctor treats you is agreed during your consultation.

5Back home

Stay in touch with us on WhatsApp – we help with follow-up questions.

Recovery step by step

First week

Bruising and swelling around the eyes usually go down within 7–10 days. The splint is removed after 5–7 days.

First month

Most of the swelling goes down. Avoid strenuous activity and follow the care instructions of your surgeon.

Months 6–12

The tissues settle slowly; the final shape of the nose usually shows after 6–12 months.

Frequently asked questions
